definitions.gloss: fixtures; furnishings; equipment (for shops, offices, events)
definitions.explanation: Movable equipment and furnishings used in commercial and institutional settings, such as display shelves, counters, tables, and racks. Distinct from permanent structural fixtures.

notes:
A business and retail term for movable equipment used in commercial spaces. Very common in the retail, hospitality, and event industries.

FORMS:
{什|じゅう} (various items, household goods) + {器|き} (vessel, equipment). The kanji {什|じゅう} originally meant "ten" or "miscellaneous items."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {什器|じゅうき}⟦{備品|びひん}→備品：16253_bihin⟧: fixtures and furnishings
- ⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧{什器|じゅうき}: store fixtures
- {什器|じゅうき}⟦レンタル→レンタル：11194_rentaru⟧: fixture rental
- {什器|じゅうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{搬入|はんにゅう}→搬入：16523_hannyuu⟧: bringing in fixtures
- {什器|じゅうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧: installation of fixtures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{備品|びひん}→備品：16253_bihin⟧: supplies, equipment — broader term covering office supplies and smaller items
- ⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧: facilities, installations — usually refers to permanent, built-in infrastructure
- ⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧: furniture — for homes, while {什器|じゅうき} is primarily for commercial use
